caption: The drawing consists of three views of decorative metal hardware, all rendered in shades of yellow, greenish-gold, and black outlines on a beige background. The top central object is an ornate escutcheon plate with a keyhole in the middle, featuring symmetrical, curved floral and leaf-like designs extending outward from the center. Below this, in the bottom left quadrant, is a matching decorative drawer or door pull, also adorned with floral and leaf motifs; it includes a solid round handle attached to an elaborate backplate. To the right of the pull, a side profile of the handle is shown, displaying its thickness and curvature. In the lower left corner, there is a scale in inches, and in the lower right, there is a handwritten signature. The entire composition is framed by a double-lined rectangular border.
title: Drawer Pull
